description: This file implements functions for sending messages to agents using the A2A Protocol with JSON-RPC 2.0, including both request and streaming request methods, along with response parsing and metadata extraction.

methods.name: extractA2AMetadata
methods.description: Extracts task metadata from A2A JSON-RPC response result, including task ID, context ID, status, and custom metadata.

methods.name: makeA2ASendMessageRequest
methods.description: Sends a non-streaming message to an A2A agent using JSON-RPC 2.0, processing the response to extract and deliver text and metadata.

methods.name: makeA2AStreamMessageRequest
methods.description: Sends a streaming message to an A2A agent via JSON-RPC 2.0 with NDJSON responses, handling incremental text chunks and updating metadata throughout the stream.
